T3_P1B_tracerBullet.theFinding: THE CONTRACT SURVIVED, THE SCHEMA'S PROSE DID NOT. The projection threw on 34 real rows: a cost field has THREE on-disk states, not two — present-with-a-number (1,388), absent (394), and PRESENT WITH value:null (34). Fourteen of those 34 carry verificationStatus VERIFIED_OFFICIAL, which is an EVIDENCED ABSENCE (the tariff was read; no separate figure is published), not a contradiction. Contract v1.1's `reason` field — added hours earlier as R3 — was exactly the right shape: chip UNKNOWN because there is no number, reason NOT_PUBLISHED because someone looked. Under v1.0's WITHHELD-with-no-reason those 14 would have been indistinguishable from 'nobody has looked yet'.
T3_P1B_tracerBullet.latticeImplementation: src/lattice.ts — implemented exactly once behind a TYPE-ONLY brand, so an engine cannot construct a result chip by hand and have it typecheck. All four propagation rules proven by test, including rule 3 (UNKNOWN absorbing, no value key emitted).

T4_conflictFixture.detail: Synthetic conflicted card (card:SYNTHETIC-FIXTURE:conflicted-fx) with two competing FX candidates. Proven end to end: the adapter returns both candidates with NO scalar value; an engine takes the CONSERVATIVE candidate (3.0%, worse for the user), downgrades to ESTIMATE, and the reason trace records the choice, the alternative and that nothing was arbitrated. worseIs direction is DECLARED, never inferred — a LOWER-is-worse test proves the inversion.

executorCapabilityUpdate.finding: A task packet passed as a command-line argument FAILS on Windows once it exceeds roughly 8 KB: cursor-agent exits immediately with 'The command line is too long.' and produces no output and no error event in the JSON stream.
executorCapabilityUpdate.workaround: Write the packet to a file inside the worktree and pass a short prompt telling the agent to read and execute it. Verified working with an 8,132-byte packet.
